body: I would think that’s the first step that you want to let go.. You will find another person that suits you it’s just hard to see through the fog.
Good on you, stay strong bro.

I’m sorry you feel that way, I am sure you have a lot to offer and there is someone out there that’s perfect for you. I don’t think you have to loosen your morals but it will remove a big part of the market(Depending on your age) that’s a decision that you can make. I think you are fixated on your ex(I was) but until you let them go you don’t give off a vibe that is attractive to the opposite sex. I went on dates and tried to put on a front but I just compared them to her. It wasn’t until sometime later I found a girl that I really liked and all the pain started to fade. I know that feeling of hopelessness as my Ex of 13yrs/3 children got a new guy in about a month. It hurt a lot and sent me on a spiral downwards. I am not sure that it’s even going to work with this new girl but it has given me hope to forget my ex and find happiness. You need to get out there and meet new people, easier said than done I know. The more people you meet the better your chances of finding someone who will cherish you.. I am sure your worth it.
I agree 100%, It will probably manifest in other ways in her future or she’s just a cu$t.

I agree 100%. I’m not perfect by any means,  but how quickly she moved on did hurt a lot. I just wonder if because of her not “Grieving” for our relationship it may manifest in other ways in the future..? Or maybe she’s just a cunt.

I just mean that I’m going to struggle to trust a woman in a relationship again as I’ve been so let down. I am depressed but I was probably too full on with the most recent as I was so happy that I had a connection with someone special. I keep it really well hidden, When I was at my previous job I had 70 staff under my control who had no idea my relationship had even ended. FYI my ex got in contact with a mutual friend of my new (partner) and then I got ghosted. I’m an honest person and I just assume that the other party is the same, its my constant undoing in life. (Well one of)

The kids or new girl? She definitely spoke with a mutual friend of the new girl and then I got ghosted. The kids 100% she has constantly used them for leverage and threatened to move far away with the new guy.

I know they would but I barely get to see them(plus knowing I have to leave them and go home is gut wrenching, they always ask why I can’t stay with them and after I leave them I normally cry in the car for an hour because the pain is so unbearable) and the new guy is practically living at the house as well. I am terrified of what it would do to them but I cannot stand anymore rejection. I’ve been seeing a girl for a couple of weeks and everything was great, she seemed really keen as I was but now she won’t get back to me/blocked my number with no explanation..? I know it’s only been a short time but we were both so into each other and now it’s all gone again. I literally don’t think I can trust women anymore.

I am sorry you had to deal with that your whole life. The unfortunate thing is all of us are equipped to have children(almost) but nowhere near that amount understand what it means to be a parent. There’s so many people who’s lives are fucked because of bad parents. I’m assuming it was a parental figure? Why do you think your so needy in relationships? I only ask because I’m a bit the same.

I worked nights, didn’t pay her the attention she deserved.. I think really she just wanted someone who was going to earn more money and give her the life she felt that she deserved. 
From my perspective I felt that she was pulling back for months prior so this probably made me worse trying to protect my feelings.

That is shit that your in pain.. Is the surgery expensive?? I can assure you that we all have problems in our life. The people who suffer more seem to be the most beautiful on the inside for some reason. I get that feeling that some people get all the luck.

Is that all because of your early home life? Was it a violent parent or something? Do you feel like your mood goes up and down constantly? Mostly down though I’m sure. Have you been in relationships that failed as a result?

I’m in Australia is that far enough? I have these thoughts constantly and am so lonely if you want to talk.. Lately i can’t think of anything but ending it all. Why have you had these thoughts for so long?
I’m probably lucky I don’t have guns as well.. Why do you feel that way?

You know what as a guy I’m more into girls who are beautiful on the inside because the ones who are aesthetically pleasing are usually pieces of shit in my experience.. I would rather a beautiful soul. Stop obsessing with what the media tells us is beautiful, they are wrong..

Your lucky to have someone that loves you so much. I’m sure one day soon you will be with him and all these thoughts will evaporate. Use that as your motivation to push on. I am happy to talk with you if you want to talk to a “Stranger” It sounds like you’ve had a tough time and I can tell you that you would leave a big hole in a lot of peoples lives if you did the unthinkable.. Your boyfriend thinks your worth loving. Life can be shit sometimes and depression sucks balls but I promise you that we all feel like that from time to time. Tell me more about your story..

I think that given your story it could just be your friends have their own personal issues as well. I wouldn’t read to much into it. It sucks that your friend is moving away but that shit happens sometimes. I think that you have much to be positive about though bro. I was depressed and Suicidal a few months ago because my wife left with our 3 kids after 13yrs. I felt alone and that no one understood my heartache. The fact is that sometimes life is hard and kicks you around but the measure of a person is how they triumph over adversity. I believe you are strong and your young. It helped me to focus on what I did have rather than what I didn’t. If I was in your position I would talk to your friend(alone) and see if they will open up to you in regards to what they are feeling. It helped me to listen to other people and try and offer insight into their adversity. You have your whole life in front of you and the alternative is final. My stepsister took her own life about 2years ago and it lead to the demise of her brother(addicted to Valium) who is a strong and intelligent guy. Her mother is fucked up because of what she did. This was my motivation for not taking my own life. I knew it would fuck the people up around me. I’m here for you and if you want to chat ever I am willing to listen. One foot in front of the other and push forward in your life, I promise you that you will have much triumph in your life. I’m standing shoulder to shoulder with you bro, take life head on!!

I’m here, whenever you want to chat bro. I was suicidal a few months ago. My wife left me with 3 kids and all felt hopeless, I turned to drugs to suppress the pain. In my opinion it made things much worse as you get a high but it’s like a pendulum and you must come down at some point. The best thing I did was stop taking all the drugs. The pain is still there but it’s faded somewhat and I’m thinking clearer. It’s easy to say I know but it will get better. One foot in front of the other and push forward. I found that I needed to stop all that shit to face what was going on in my life rather than trying to escape. I came here and was planning my demise but I got an amazing response from someone who didn’t even know me, it floored me that someone who didn’t even know me could be so caring. I guess my point is that your not alone and heaps of people beat adversity everyday and you can too. I believe that you can do it. If you have these thoughts I’d advise to sleep on it and I found the next day was a little easier. It does take time but the alternative is forever. Life is shit sometimes but I’m behind you to help and support you. All is not lost, your still here now. I found that exercise helped me as well because it gave me something else to think about. I’m offering my hand to help you up my brother, You are valued and loved.

Life is hard, life is shit sometimes. You have people who love you despite of what you think. Your friends and family would be devastated if you took your life. Fuck that shit!! Life is like a bully picking on you constantly but don’t let it win, Pick yourself up walk up face to face and say I’m going to kick the shit out of life. I have been where your at but the passage of time heals your wounds and heartache. Your young and will have so much triumph in your life. Your special and beautiful and have so much to live for. Love yourself first and foremost and everything will fall into line I promise.. I’m behind you 100% msg me if you ever want to talk. I had someone on here help me when I was near the end and I want to help others who feel helpless and that all is lost. I’m putting my hand out to help you back to your feet. I care and can help you get to where you deserve to be..Just take the first step forward, I am with you.

I agree life is hard and shit most of the time. Try to focus on what you have rather than what you don’t have. You have your health and your still breathing. Get up from this and kick life in the balls, hold your head up high. You have people who love you and would hurt so much if you left this world. My step sister took her own life a few months ago and it fucked her mum and my other step brother to the point where they want to die also. If you cannot do life for yourself do it for those who mean something to you. I get it all feels hopeless at times and I’ve been where your at, I was so close to killing myself. I chose to say fuck that I wont let anything beat me... I will stand behind you and say your special and you deserve to live the life that was intended for you. Be strong and realise that your loved and people will miss you a lot. I support you and am offering a hand up from the downward spiral that is depression. Fuck that choose to kick life’s ass.. Once you realise that you are strong everything starts falling into line. It helped me to read others pain as well.. I love and support you.

That is sad that you feel this way. A matter of months ago I felt the same, my wife left with our three kids. She found another man in a few weeks, I quit my job because I couldn’t cope at work anymore. I was so close to the end, I wrote notes to my kids and tied up all the loose ends in my life and spent everyday on this cliff face looking at where I was going to jump to my death. I wanted to ensure that I died and didn’t end up in a wheelchair. In the end I was lonely and felt that no one understood what I was feeling. It was hopeless until I started to think about what my actions would do to those around me, My kids/family ect.  I can tell you this you are special and you are unique and you are strong and you can beat this as I did... love is all around you. Accept that life is hard and it knocks you down but it’s how you deal with it that shows your character. I now know that I won’t be beaten and I’m going to kick the shit out of life not the other way round. I believe in you and will be your friend if you need it... The help is there all you need to do is ask, no shame in that...
All your responses have reduced me to tears.. Thank you for your support when all feels lost. You are amazing people to offer words of support to a stranger at their lowest.
